MKB-bedrijven worstelen vaak met het aut: SMEs often struggle to automatically link mobile payment flows to their accounting, causing reconciliation to be manual, delays in cash visibility, and an increased risk of errors.
Een marktvoorspelling geeft aan dat een: A market forecast indicates that an open Twinfield API for mobile payments may be on the horizon (hypothesis).
Steeds meer klanten betalen mobiel (wall: More and more customers pay via mobile (wallets, QR, paylinks) and that payment data needs to be accurately reflected in the accounting.
Fouten in omzetrapportage en kaspositie: Errors in revenue reporting and cash position continue to occur.
Verhoogd risico bij audits en btw-aangif: Increased risk during audits and VAT filings due to inconsistent data.
Kies voor automatisering als je maandeli: Choose automation if you have > 200 transactions per month or if your reconciliation costs > 4 hours per month.
Overweeg uitstel als transactievrijheid: Consider postponement if transaction freedom is low and IT/accounting capacity is limited — in that case document one simple fallback procedure.
